traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The priestess is a 3th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The priestess has the following cleric spells prepared: * Cantrips (at will): guidance, sacred flame * 1st level (4 slots): bless, cure wounds, divine favor, shield of faith * 2nd level (2 slots): magic weapon, spiritual weapon

traits.name: Guided Strike (1/Short Rest)
traits.text:
When the priestess
makes an attack roll, it can gain a +10 bonus to the
roll.
